subject: Project Kestrel kickoff: ETC as our long-document encoder
body:
Team,

Kicking off the ETC standardization effort. Internally this effort is Project Kestrel - please use that name in docs, channels, and cluster job tags so everything rolls up cleanly.

The why: half the portfolio hits the same wall - Transformers that can't encode long or structured inputs. Our open-source ETC release solves exactly that (it's the EMNLP 2020 "Encoding Long and Structured Inputs in Transformers" work), and the repo already separates core Keras layers - compatible with both TF1 and TF2 - from the fine-tuning and example-generation code. We make it the paved path.

Milestones for Mar 2 - May 18: layers packaged with the unit-test suite (the discover -s etcmodel -p '*_test.py' set) green in CI by Mar 27, fine-tuning recipe reproduced on one long-document dataset from the release by Apr 24, adoption guide + review by May 15.

Santiago owns staffing and TPU capacity.

Dmitri
